label: p0 sweep: four times the minibatch, four times fewer gradient steps
notes:
Batch p0, desktop half -- the PPO tuning sweep, one knob per arm off the p0a reference
(lr 3e-4, gamma 0.99, lambda 0.98, entropy 0.01, fc 320, rollout 128x128, 4 epochs, minibatch 256).

10M transitions, not 3M: every arm of p0's first wave was still rising at its 3M cap, so a best30 read
at 3M is a read of the cap and not of the config.

A PPO step IS a transition IS a game move, so 10M here is directly comparable to b2's 18M
(3M counted steps x 6) and to any snek2 number. Do not multiply.

Judged in this order, per the user 2026-08-29: (1) peak best30, (2) consistency -- how much the
trailing rate wobbles once it is up, (3) speed to get there, which matters least. All three are in
runs/<policy>_evals.json.

Reward knobs are stated explicitly as well as via SNEK_REWARD_PRESET=b2, deliberately: the preset is
new code (122397b51) and a spec that relied on it alone would run UNSHAPED against any older
checkout, silently. The explicit knobs also make the spec readable on its own.
